profile.name: r3verse
profile.bio: I turn raw footage into cinematic stories. From smooth transitions and dynamic pacing to color grading and sound design, I create videos that capture attention and leave an impact.
profile.aboutText: I'm a video editor passionate about transforming raw footage into engaging visual experiences. I focus on storytelling, rhythm, transitions, color grading, and sound design to bring every project to life.
profile.aboutDetail: From the first cut to the final color grade, every detail matters.
profile.skillsIntro: My creative toolkit combines storytelling, technical precision, and a passion for visual experimentation.
profile.contactText: Have a video in mind? Let's bring your vision to life. Get in touch to collaborate on your next project.
profile.footerText: Crafted frame by frame. Edited with purpose.
